title: The Gateway Arch- Stepping into America’s West (2/2)
titleZh: 大拱門──走進美國西部的門戶（2/2）
summaryZh: 談大拱門每年的遊客人數，以及設計師留下的另一件知名作品。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — America's National Parks

sentences.text: National Park Service information shows that about 2.4 million people visited the arch in 2023. Saarinen died in 1961. While
sentences.zh: 美國國家公園管理局的資料顯示，二〇二三年約有兩百四十萬人造訪這座拱門。Saarinen 在一九六一年過世。雖然

sentences.text: he never saw his arch built, his design lives on.
sentences.zh: 他從沒親眼看到拱門蓋好，他的設計卻流傳了下來。

sentences.text: Saarinen also designed another American landmark, the TWA Flight Center at John F. Kennedy Airport in the city of New York.
sentences.zh: Saarinen 還設計了另一個美國地標，就是紐約市甘迺迪機場的環球航空航廈。
